E D U C A T I O N

C O R E C O M P E T E N C I E S

M.Com (2004) – Marathwada University, Aurangabad, Maharashtra – 72% Company Secretary Executive (Passed - 2009) | Company Secretary Professional Programme – Attempted

Global Transaction Processing

Securities Settlement & Custody Operations Trade Finance & Foreign Exchange (FX) Settlement (SWIFT MT Series) Equity, Fixed Income & Derivative Instruments Mutual Funds & Money Market Instruments (CP, CD, Repos) Cross-Border Fund Transfers & Client Communication Regulatory Compliance, KYC / AML Awareness & Due Diligence Risk Assessment, Internal Controls & Control Testing Fraud Detection & Exception Handling

Mukesh Jha

P R O F I L E S U M M A R Y

❖ Seasoned and detail-oriented Finance Operations Professional with over 14 years of comprehensive experience in global transaction processing, custodian banking operations, and securities settlement. Currently designated as Team Leader / Assistant Manager at State Street Corporate Services, a premier global custodian bank, managing critical financial operations and supporting clients across India, APAC, EMEA and North America.

❖ Demonstrates

in both trade, cash operations and payment investigation encompassing electronic trade processing, security movement, and post- trade lifecycle management. Proficient in handling cash receipts and disbursements via SWIFT (MT202), foreign exchange settlements, netting, and fee-based fund transfers. Experienced in a wide range of financial instruments including equity, fixed income securities, mutual funds, derivatives, and money market instruments such as CPs, CDs, and repos. Possesses sound knowledge about the different clearinghouses like CREST, EUROCLEAR, DTC , FED and so on to enable securities settlement

in-depth expertise

❖ Demonstrates in-depth expertise in wealth management/financial planning platform in handling international customers/process. Already worked as a client facing role in one of the top custodian bank State Street Corporate Services and have excellent client service delivery experience. Worked in US Time zone follow client holiday calander. ❖ Proficiency in MS Office, Worked on Bloomberg, Reuters,IDC,JPM, Markit. . ❖ Demonstrates in-depth expertise in Project Management experience for the

Wealth Management domain.

❖ Strong ‘’ASANA’’ tool knowledge/usage or experience in any other ‘’Work Management Platform’’ for effectively managing and collaborating on tasks and projects.

❖ Fluent in MSFT(Microsoft Office 365) suite.

❖ Highly skilled in error/claim analysis, MIS reporting, and SLA-based service delivery, with a strong record of client interfacing, particularly with operations and service teams across the UK and US. Possesses deep understanding of KYC, AML, regulatory compliance, and financial risk frameworks, ensuring accuracy and alignment with industry best practices.

❖ Known for identifying and mitigating operational risks, driving process standardization, supporting transitions of banking products within international trade, and facilitating compliance and audit reviews. Successfully formulated new policies and procedures, driving business growth, cost-reduction, and efficiency improvements through structured process redesign, resource planning, and productivity management.

❖ Demonstrated success in planning and executing banking-related processes, maximizing account profitability, improving liquidity positions, and delivering enhanced returns. Strong experience in developing operational strategies, defining SLA/KPI frameworks, ensuring TAT compliance, and aligning manpower effectively to deliver seamless service.

❖ Played a strategic role in client relationship management, building service standards for operational excellence, and leading initiatives that enhanced customer experience and retention. Recognized as a visionary professional capable of driving organizational transformation, developing AOPs, and contributing directly to top-line and bottom-line growth.

❖ Accomplished in project management, successfully leading the entire project lifecycle from planning to delivery, while ensuring cost optimization, interdisciplinary coordination, and documentation compliance. Acted as a key contributor in multiple successful process migrations, including North American transactions, image application, and the GTM Blotter to TXR system transition. Served as BCP Coordinator and SharePoint Committee Representative, ensuring business continuity and SOP governance.

❖ Renowned for implementing strong internal controls, conducting risk assessments, and executing quality audits. Excelled at mentoring teams, leading up to 10 professionals, facilitating performance improvement through training workshops, and embedding LEAN initiatives that earned multiple performance and innovation awards.

❖ Notable for championing process transformation—identifying inefficiencies, redesigning workflows, and enhancing service delivery with measurable gains in efficiency, accuracy, and compliance. Known for initiatives, attaining breakthrough performance levels, and enhancing operational quality standards.

leading change management

❖ Holds an M.Com degree along with Company Secretary Executive certification. Open to leveraging this versatile experience across investment operations, O2C/R2R functions, middle-office roles, fund accounting, or risk and compliance functions—ideally based in Mumbai or Pune, while remaining open to broader opportunities within financial operations and shared services environments.

W O R K E X P E R I E N C E State Street Corporate Services Mumbai Pvt. Ltd. | Team Leader / Assistant Manager – Global Transaction Processing | Since 2008 Key Achievements & Responsibilities: Leadership & People Management: ❖ Leading a cross-functional team to ensure timely and error-free execution of trades across

asset classes, consistently achieving 100% SLA adherence and high accuracy.

❖ Conducting targeted performance reviews and designing customized training

interventions that improved underperformers’ productivity.

❖ Recognized with 9 Manager Awards, 3 “Titan of the Month” awards, and 4 Converge

Performance Awards (Q4 2014, Q1/Q2/Q4 2015) for exceptional leadership and delivery.

T E C H N I C A L S K I L L S

MS Office Suite: Proficient in Excel, Word, PowerPoint

MIS & Dashboard Tools: Excel-based dashboards and reporting

Internet Applications: Web-based workflow tools and research

SWIFT Messaging: MT202, MT series

Securities Platforms: Trade settlement and custody systems

KPI/SLA Tools: Tracking and analysis for performance optimization

Compliance Systems: KYC/AML tools and documentation platforms

S O F T S K I L L S

Strategic Thinking & Visionary Leadership

Decision-Making & Problem-Solving

Negotiation & Persuasion

Active Listening & Effective Communication

Stakeholder & Relationship Management

Communication & Executive Presence

Leadership & People Development

Emotional Intelligence & Cultural Awareness

Conflict Management

High Business Ethics & Trustworthy

Risk & Control Management: ❖ Spearheaded risk assessments, internal control testing, and root cause analysis of

processing errors; introduced control measures that reduced error rates.

❖ Actively escalated and resolved control weaknesses, enabling data-driven decision-making

across trade processing operations.

❖ Served as a Control Oversight Team Member (2011), ensuring strict compliance with

regulatory guidelines and internal SOPs.

Operational Excellence & Transformation: ❖ Played a pivotal role in the migration of multiple critical processes including:

o North American Region Operations and Image Application from State Street Pune. o GTM Blotter to TXR Application, enhancing trade visibility and reducing

turnaround time.

❖

Initiated and led multiple LEAN projects, earning the Top Lean Idea Award (2014) for the highest number of process improvement suggestions.

❖ Delivered $xxxK+ in operational efficiencies through automation, improved MIS

reporting, and trade lifecycle optimizations.

Securities & Trade Processing: ❖ Managed end-to-end security settlement instructions across equities, fixed income,

mutual funds, and derivatives.

❖ Processed money market instruments including CPs, CDs, and bi-party repos; handled

internal fund transfers, CUSIP switchovers, and cross-border transactions.

❖ Ensured accurate trade accounting and fund setup to support NAV calculations and client

reporting.

Client Relationship Management: ❖ Liaised with clients and service teams across UK & US geographies to resolve trade

exceptions, settlements, and custody operations queries.

❖ Delivered real-time equity and cash position updates and investment advice, earning

commendations from clients for timely settlement of high-value trades.

Governance & Compliance: ❖ Maintained audit-ready MIS dashboards (daily/weekly/monthly productivity reports) and

timesheets for operational transparency.

❖ BCP Coordinator for the unit and member of Quick Response Team, ensuring seamless

continuity during disruptions.

❖ Member of the SharePoint SOP Committee, accountable for timely documentation and

updates of all standard processes.

P E R S O N A L D E T A I L S Languages Known: English, Hindi & Marathi Address: Thane, 401107, Mumbai, Maharashtra
